record.title: Evaluate the finite ADC command-loop experiment
record.intent: Choose the next smallest environment hypothesis from the observed boundary or mismatch.
requirements: Distinguish static predictions, live bindings, completed synthetic transactions and uncompleted accesses.
Treat any mismatch as a conclusion requiring deliberate re-planning rather than changing the current fixture.
acceptance: Select and justify the next bounded batch or concrete blocker, with all conclusions committed and pushed before another experiment.
